verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a self-hosted deployment in which you run the infrastructure that stores experiment logs, traces, datasets and prompts in your own cloud account and region (docs-10, docs-32, docs-57). However, the same docs say Braintrust still provides the managed UI, authentication and platform updates, so this is a hybrid data-plane deployment rather than self-hosting the whole core product. Missing for 10: self-hostable UI, auth and control plane (fully on-prem or air-gapped operation), deployment and setup detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.
